items.briefing:
Australian organisations are facing a growing double threat: AI is now being used to accelerate attacks on older, unpatched systems, while AI-generated phishing emails have become sophisticated enough to bypass most detection tools. If your organisation relies on legacy software or ageing infrastructure, the risk of compromise is increasing. Staff should also be aware that AI chatbot conversations — including those on tools like ChatGPT — may be reviewed by human staff at those companies, so sensitive work information should never be shared through these platforms.

Microsoft has also issued emergency security patches following its recent major update cycle — IT teams should ensure Windows devices are fully updated as soon as possible. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email asking you to click a link or provide information, verify the request directly with the sender by phone before taking any action.

featured.title: AI speeds up cyber attacks on ageing systems, experts warn
featured.summary: Ageing technology is leaving critical services exposed as AI lets attackers exploit known weaknesses at machine speed, experts say.
